summary: CMB.TECH NV filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated October 13, 2026 announcing the sale of one Suezmax tanker, the Stella (2011-built, 165,000 dwt), with delivery already completed to the new owners. The disposal generates an estimated gain of roughly $59.6 million in Q4 2026 based on net sale price versus book value. No price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is stated. The sale is an ordinary fleet-renewal asset disposal under the company's diversified maritime strategy; watch for Q4 2026 results on November 26, 2026 and any further fleet-sale updates.
